content.title: Omeros: Q3 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: SEATTLE (AP) — Omeros Corporation OMER on Thursday reported a loss of $30.9 million in its third quarter. On a per-share basis, the Seattle-based company said it had a loss of 47 cents. Losses, adjusted to account for discontinued operations and non-recurring costs, were 19 cents per share.
